edges.reason: transfer uses msg.sender as the _from argument when forwarding to transferFrom
transfer returns transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value), forwarding all execution
msg.sender is compared against _from and used as the allowance spender in transferFrom
transferFrom requires ensure(_from,_to,_value), gating every transfer through the whitelist
ensure compares _from/_to against owner to bypass sale conditions
ensure reads canSale[_from] to grant a whitelist bypass
ensure compares _from against the tradeAddress whitelist slot
ensure calls condition(_from,_value) for non-whitelisted senders
ensure calls pairFor to compute the Uniswap pair address _UNI
the UNI router constant is used in the ensure whitelist comparison
transferFrom reads and writes balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] without SafeMath
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] after checking it
transferFrom performs the unchecked subtraction and addition on balances
the unchecked balance update directly mutates the balanceOf mapping
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] using the caller identity
approve unconditionally overwrites the allowance mapping entry
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before executing arbitrary code
delegate reads the owner state variable for its authorization check
delegate executes a.delegatecall(b), giving full storage control to an arbitrary target
parameter a supplies the attacker-controlled delegatecall target address
parameter b supplies the arbitrary delegatecall payload
mints requires msg.sender == owner or a hardcoded privileged address
mints reads owner for its authorization check
mints computes addedValue*(10**decimals) without SafeMath
the unchecked multiplication overwrites balanceOf[spender], destroying existing balances
mints sets canSale[spender] = true, whitelisting arbitrary addresses
init requires msg.sender == owner before changing sale limits
init reads owner for its authorization check
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before mass transferring
batchSend debits and credits balanceOf without SafeMath
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length with unchecked multiplication
the unchecked batch arithmetic mutates balances for every recipient
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner before changing the whitelist
setTradeAddress writes an arbitrary address into the tradeAddress whitelist slot
setTradeAddress reads owner for its authorization check
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, establishing the privileged role
constructor uses msg.sender as the initial owner and supply holder
constructor assigns the full supply to balanceOf[msg.sender]
constructor sets totalSupply from the supplied amount and decimals
constructor grants uint(-1) allowance to the UNI router address
the _from parameter is the address tested against owner, UNI, tradeAddress and canSale in ensure
the _to parameter is compared against owner inside ensure
the _from parameter indexes the balanceOf and allowance mappings in transferFrom
the _to parameter is credited in balanceOf by transferFrom
the _value parameter drives the unchecked allowance and balance arithmetic in transferFrom
batchSend._value is the multiplicand of the unchecked total computation
the _tos array drives the owner-only mass balance credit loop
local total is the unchecked product of _value and _tos.length
each loop-local _to address has its balanceOf entry increased without SafeMath
loop index i controls iteration over _tos in batchSend
mints.spender is the balanceOf key overwritten by the unchecked mint arithmetic
mints.addedValue is the operand of the unchecked 10**decimals multiplication
setTradeAddress.addr is written directly into the tradeAddress whitelist state variable

normalization_plan.reason: The _from parameter only exists to index transferFrom's balance and whitelist logic and should be folded into the transferFrom function node
The _to parameter is a local binding of transferFrom's credit destination and merges into the transferFrom function node
The _value parameter directly feeds the unchecked balance update, so it normalizes into the unchecked_balance_update unsafe operation
batchSend._value is the multiplicand of the unchecked total computation and normalizes into the unchecked_batch_arithmetic node
The _tos recipient array is the iteration target of the batchSend loop and merges into the batchSend function node
The local total is precisely the unchecked product computed by the unchecked_batch_arithmetic node
The loop-local _to is only the per-iteration recipient inside batchSend and merges into the batchSend function node
The loop index i only controls the batchSend iteration and merges into the batchSend function node
delegate.b is the raw payload handed to the delegatecall unsafe operation and normalizes into that node
delegate.a is the target address consumed by the delegatecall unsafe operation and normalizes into that node
mints.spender is the storage slot overwritten by the unchecked mint multiplication and normalizes into the unchecked_mint_multiply node
mints.addedValue is the operand of the unchecked mint multiplication and normalizes into the unchecked_mint_multiply node
The addr parameter is simply assigned to tradeAddress by setTradeAddress and merges into the setTradeAddress function node
